# Mediocre Souvenir Co.

> Genuine Merch for Overlooked Places. Faux-vintage souvenir t-shirts for
> more than 650 unglamorous, overlooked towns across Canada and the United
> States, commemorated with the exact reverence a Hawaii gift shop would
> use. Deadpan, affectionate, never mean toward the places. Est. 2026.

## Quick facts

- Product: one souvenir t-shirt per real town, in up to four print styles.
- Catalogue: 2,154 shirts. 1,680 for US towns across all 50 states, 474 for
  Canadian towns across all 13 provinces and territories.
- Print styles: Varsity (arched college lettering), Greetings (a
  greetings-from postcard), I Heart (the classic heart souvenir), and Tour
  (laid out like a concert tour shirt, with the town as the headline date).
- Blank: Comfort Colors 1717. Garment-dyed heavyweight, 100% ring-spun
  cotton. Unisex fit, sizes S to 3XL.
- Price: $36 USD per shirt.
- Multi-buy: 15% off two shirts, 20% off three or more. Automatic at
  checkout, mix and match any towns, no code needed.
- First order: 10% off with code POSTCARDS10 after signing up for the
  newsletter. It does not stack with the multi-buy discount.
- Shipping to Canada and the US: $6.95 USD, free on orders of $60 or more.
  Delivery takes about 8 to 18 days to the US and 11 to 22 days to Canada,
  including printing.
- Shipping elsewhere: from $10 USD, by order value. Ships to most countries.
- Returns: 30 days from delivery, no restocking fee.
- Every shirt is printed to order in North America.

## Who it is for

- People from small or overlooked towns, and people who moved away from one.
- Gifts for parents, grandparents and friends tied to a hometown.
- Road-trippers, collectors of deadpan souvenirs, and anyone whose town has
  never had a souvenir shirt.

## Key pages

- / : home, with town search ("find your town")
- /collections/all-souvenirs : the full catalogue
- /collections/canada and /collections/united-states : by country
- /collections/<state-or-province> : one page per state and province, for
  example /collections/ohio or /collections/british-columbia
- /collections/varsity, /collections/greetings, /collections/i-heart,
  /collections/tour : by print style
- /products/<town>-<state-code>-<style> : one page per shirt, for example
  /products/pittsfield-ma-varsity
- /request-a-town : ask for a town that is not in the catalogue yet
- /size-guide : measurements and fit advice
- /materials : the Comfort Colors 1717 garment
- /shipping-returns and /policies/refund-policy : delivery and returns
- /faq : common questions
- /journal : editorial about overlooked towns and souvenirs

## Voice and integrity

The humour is entirely in the sincerity. We never mock the towns. We never
fabricate reviews, ratings, sales counts or press.
